name: Skill Harness
description: Discovers relevant skills and experiences before replies and injects routing context via before_prompt_build hook.

qmd.description: Required QMD remote services for skill and experience search. Each service may use an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and an optional direct API key.

timeoutMs.description: QMD remote embedding and query-expansion request budget in milliseconds. Defaults to timeoutMs.

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL for OpenAI-compatible embeddings. If omitted, resolved from the OpenClaw provider prefix in model.

model.description: Embedding model name or OpenClaw 'provider/model' reference (e.g. 'bifrost/text-embedding-3-small').

apiKey.description: Optional API key for embeddings. If omitted, resolved from the OpenClaw provider or environment.

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL for OpenAI-compatible expansion. If omitted, resolved from the OpenClaw provider prefix in model.

model.description: Expansion model name or OpenClaw 'provider/model' reference (e.g. 'bifrost/gpt-4o-mini').

apiKey.description: Optional API key for expansion. If omitted, resolved from the OpenClaw provider or environment.

indexRefreshIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between source checks for QMD experience and skill index refreshes; 0 disables subsequent automatic checks.

jev.description: TypeSafe Jev provider for unified skill and experience candidate routing.

baseUrl.description: Optional base URL for TypeSafe Jev. If omitted, resolved from the OpenClaw provider prefix in model or TYPESAFE_BASE_URL.

model.description: TypeSafe Jev model name or OpenClaw 'provider/model' reference (e.g. 'typesafe/jev-latest' or 'openrouter/typesafe/jev-latest').

apiKey.description: Optional API key for TypeSafe Jev. If omitted, resolved from the OpenClaw provider, TYPESAFE_API_KEY, or environment.

sharedRoots.description: Absolute local skill directories intentionally shared with every agent. Agent-local roots retain precedence.

suppressNativeExtraDirs.description: When enabled, normalizes OpenClaw skills.load.extraDirs to [] on startup because Skill Harness uses skills.sharedRoots instead.

workingSet.description: Plugin-owned static skill working sets. Agent-specific skills are listed before shared defaults.

defaults.description: Default skills made available to every agent's working set.

agents.description: Agent-specific skill lists keyed by agent ID.

includeWorkspaceSkills.description: Whether to automatically discover and append workspace-only skills (<workspaceDir>/skills/) to the static working set.

includeWorkshopSkills.description: Whether to automatically discover and append agent-specific workshop skills (.openclaw/agents/<agentId>/agent/workshop-skills/) to the agent's static working set.

suppressNativeSkillPrompt.description: When enabled, automatically ensures agents.defaults.skills is [] and removes agents.entries.*.skills in openclaw.json on startup to suppress duplicate native OpenClaw <available_skills> prompts.

collectionWeights.description: Relative weights (positive floats or integers, e.g. 1.5, 0.8) for weighted RRF across skill collections. Defaults to meta: 3, body: 2, references: 1.

meta.description: Relative RRF weight (positive float or integer, e.g. 1.5, 0.8) for the skill-meta collection.

body.description: Relative RRF weight (positive float or integer, e.g. 1.5, 0.8) for the skill-body collection.

references.description: Relative RRF weight (positive float or integer, e.g. 1.5, 0.8) for the skill-references collection.

routing.description: Pre-turn dynamic routing thresholds and candidate selection.

scope.description: Session, chat, and agent qualification for dynamic routing.

agents.description: Agent IDs eligible for dynamic routing.

chatTypes.description: Which chat types are eligible for dynamic routing.

allowedChatIds.description: Allow-list of chat IDs for dynamic routing.

deniedChatIds.description: Deny-list of chat IDs for dynamic routing.

search.description: Direct SkillExperience retrieval used only while building prompt candidates.

minCandidateScore.description: Inclusive semantic-evidence score required for a retrieved experience to enter the candidate pool.

timeoutMs.description: Optional millisecond override for prompt-build experience retrieval. Defaults to qmd.timeoutMs.

relevanceThreshold.description: Inclusive relevance threshold for candidate experience selection.

maxInjectedExperiences.description: Maximum input-matched experiences injected into advisory context.

skills.description: Prompt-build input-matched skill candidate policy. It does not change skill_search tool results.

search.description: Direct SkillRouter retrieval used only while building prompt candidates.

minCandidateScore.description: Inclusive semantic-evidence score required for a retrieved skill to enter the candidate pool.

timeoutMs.description: Optional millisecond override for prompt-build retrieval, including query expansion. Defaults to qmd.timeoutMs.

maxEditDistance.description: Maximum classic Levenshtein distance for a name token typo.

minJaccardScore.description: Inclusive typo-aware token-set Jaccard score required for a name candidate.

genericTokens.description: Tokens that suppress only a one-token name-match request after normalization.

relevanceThreshold.description: Inclusive relevance threshold for candidate skill selection.

maxInjectedSkills.description: Maximum input-matched skills injected into advisory context.

timeoutMs.description: Budget in milliseconds for unified routing.

queryMode.description: Context sent to routing LLM: latest message only, recent turns, or full history.

contextWindow.description: Turn and character limits for recent conversation context.

review.description: Optional asynchronous post-turn Review. It evaluates turns and maintains experiences but never participates in the current route decision.

model.description: Explicit dedicated model for Review runs. If unset, inherits the top-level model before current-session and agent-primary resolution.

modelFallback.description: Last-resort Intent Review model after explicit, current-session, and agent-primary resolution. It is not a runtime retry model.

thinking.description: Thinking level for the Review sub-agent.

timeoutSeconds.description: Budget in seconds for each Review sub-agent run.
